# vaulted-null Provider





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `aws_kms_key_id` (String) Either AWS KMS key ARN or AWS KMS key alias, used to decrypt. Make sure AWS_REGION and/or AWS_PROFILE environment variables are pointing to an AWS account that has the given KMS key. When specified, this enables AWS KMS decryption. For encryption, you can optionally provide a public key; if no public key is provided, only decryption will be available. This setting has higher priority than `private_key_content`.
- `aws_profile` (String) AWS profile to use when authenticating against AWS. Equivalent of `AWS_PROFILE` env var that also works. In practice only useful when `aws_kms_key_id` is provided
- `aws_region` (String) AWS Region to use where `aws_kms_key_id` is present.
- `private_key_content` (String, Sensitive) Content of private key used to decrypt. This setting has higher priority than `private_key_path`.
- `private_key_path` (String) Path to private key used to decrypt. This setting has lower priority than `private_key_content`.
- `public_key_content` (String) Content of public key used to encrypt. This setting has higher priority than `public_key_path`.
- `public_key_path` (String) Path to public key used to decrypt. This setting has lower priority than `public_key_content`.
